summary: Accessing arguments.callee on an unmapped arguments object throws TypeError, including strict functions and non-strict functions with non-simple parameter lists.

target.template: JsRuntime.ThrowTypeError("'callee' is not accessible on unmapped arguments")
target.notes: CreateUnmappedArgumentsObject installs the restricted callee accessor. This applies beyond strict mode: non-simple parameter lists also use an unmapped arguments object.

semantics.applies_to: strict functions and non-strict functions whose arguments object is unmapped

caveats: Non-strict functions with a simple parameter list use a mapped arguments object and have legacy callee semantics handled separately/runtime.

tests.name: strict callee throws
tests.input: function f(){'use strict'; return arguments.callee;} try{f()}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}

tests.name: non-simple sloppy parameters are also unmapped
